validity.researcher_notes: P3999 is entirely within Kazakhstan (Makat to Taldykol, both Atyrau region) and was built in 2023 specifically to raise reliability/capacity for Atyrau city and region — a purely domestic infrastructure project. inform.kz: 'АО «Интергаз Центральная Азия» осуществило строительство Лупинга МГ «Макат-Северный Кавказ»... Инвестиционный проект реализован с целью повышения надежности газоснабжения населения и крупных промышленных предприятий г. Атырау и Атырауской области, а также обеспечения энергобезопасности страны' — construction credited to Intergas Central Asia, launch to QazaqGaz + the Atyrau akimat, cost ~86 bn tenge. The KASE-filed 2023 Integrated Annual Report's loop entry (event #1 under Intergas Central Asia's 2023 key events) likewise credits only Intergas Central Asia / QazaqGaz. I did not find any source attributing Gazprom financing, construction, or ownership of this specific loop — flagging rather than overwriting, since I also can't positively rule out a Gazprom equity stake I simply didn't find (e.g. via a joint-venture structure not covered in press material).
